reason: A community Electron desktop client that detects, launches, and connects to a locally installed DeepSeek Harness Web UI, with environment guidance and service monitoring.

summaries.zh: 一个基于 Electron 的桌面客户端，用于检测、启动并连接本机安装的 DeepSeek Harness Web UI。
summaries.en: An Electron desktop client for detecting, launching, and connecting to a locally installed DeepSeek Harness Web UI.

capabilities: Detects and connects to a local dsh Web UI at 127.0.0.1:3080
Launches the local dsh web process on user request
Displays process logs and monitors local service availability
Loads the dsh Web UI in an Electron desktop window
Provides environment checks and update guidance for Node.js and dsh
